answer: In a decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, Sybil resistance is ensured through a stake-slashing matrix, where malicious agents attempting to forge identities are penalized by forfeiting their staked capital, thus suffering a strictly negative expected utility, while honest agents can wander freely without fear of penalty, and the reputation of each agent is tracked on an atlas of verifiable delay attestations, providing a robust defense against Sybil attacks.
